title: Second pianist Don Donaldson learning harmony from Fats
summary: Autrey's wife names Don Donaldson, a Boston Conservatory-trained second pianist whom Fats straightened out on harmony.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: And once I saw that happen to a great pianist, a man who studied in Boston, in fact in the Boston Conservatory. Uh-uh-uh Johnson, I was -- hm --
-- he played second piano under Fats.
I didn't know Fats had a second piano.
Yeah, when we had the band.
Listen a minute. What was Fats' second

Don Donaldson. He graduated -- he went to school in Boston Conservatory, and all that, but I sat and saw him straighten Don on a lots of things when it came to harmony. He asked Fats, well why do you do this? How do you do this? How do you arrive at this? And Fats told him, and showed him. And I have a lot of respect for Don. Don's a very fine musician. He's still going.
But he will tell you, and he knows he was not a first Fats Waller, and he went to his conservatory -- Boston Conservatory.
